channel.title: BBC News | WORLD
channel.description: Updated every minute of every day

item.title: Groups vow attacks after Gaza raid
item.description: Palestinian militants say they will launch new suicide attacks inside Israel after a dawn raid on a Hamas stronghold leaves 14 dead.

item.title: Atlantis blasts off
item.description: A new mission to the International Space Station begins after a long delay caused by technical problems and bad weather.

item.title: Bush to address nation on Iraq
item.description: The president is to try to keep up public support for his tough stand on Iraq in a televised speech as Congress rallies behind him.

item.title: Battle rages for Ivory Coast city
item.description: Government troops launch a foray into the centre of rebel-held stronghold of Bouake¸ after ceasefire talks collapse.

item.title: Brazil's Lula woos rivals
item.description: Left-wing leader Lula appeals to opponents of Brazil's economic model to support him in the second round of voting on 27 October.
